name: Global navbar
purpose: Persistent site chrome. Mounted once outside the router, so it is present on every route and is never page content.
contentNote: Intentionally empty. The navbar's links are a global constant in the source, not per-page content — a PageSpec must not be able to redefine them.

motion.detail: logo 1000ms, links 1100ms, right actions 1200ms; distance -12px, duration 400ms, ease-out. The submenu panel stays MOUNTED and animates its own height (opacity/visibility/transform .15s, height .25s) — it is never conditionally rendered.

desktop.behavior: 3 ghost triggers + a full-bleed submenu panel pinned at y=80
